stories.summary_de: Immanuel Wilkins nahm drei Stunden seines Auftritts im New Yorker Jazz-Club Village Vanguard auf. Das daraus entstandene Live-Album zählt zu den besten der Jazzgeschichte.

stories.headline_en: Art historian Simon Houfe dies at 83
stories.summary_en: Simon Houfe, writer, art historian and journalist, has died aged 83. He edited Antique Collector (1970–74) and wrote nine books while contributing to Country Life and Apollo.

stories.headline_en: Aardman founders Lord and Sproxton knighted
stories.summary_en: Aardman Animations co-founders Peter Lord and David Sproxton were knighted this year. The studio, which created Morph and Wallace & Gromit, became employee-owned in 2018.

stories.headline_en: Canadian agency exposed Morrisseau forgeries
stories.summary_en: An obscure Canadian agency helped convict forgers of Norval Morrisseau works and is now receiving recognition for its role. Forged Morrisseau pieces had been produced since at least 1996.

stories.headline_en: Rencontres d'Arles Examines Photography's Political Centers

stories.summary_en: The latest edition of the annual Rencontres d'Arles festival reveals tensions between art and politics. The festival shows how the art world's political consensus is more fragmented than often imagined.

stories.headline_en: V&A workers vote to strike over pay and conditions

stories.headline_en: Matthew Barney Sculpture Follows Aspen Performance

stories.summary_en: Matthew Barney has created a new sculpture titled Remote on a Colorado ranch. The work relates to a performance presented at the Aspen Art Museum's AIR festival.
